title: Dragon NFX MAG OTG Ski Goggles (Icon Rose)

comparisons.notes: Variant Icon Rose / LumaLens Rose Gold Ion + Light Rose, in stock; same colorway and lens set (different season barcode).

writeup: Dragon's NFX MAG OTG goggles in the Icon Rose colorway with a LumaLens Rose Gold Ionized lens are new on Woot for $49.99, while evo sells the same colorway for $195.96. The OTG frame fits over prescription glasses, and Swiftlock magnetic lens changes make swaps quick. Woot's box lists only the goggles, so don't count on a bonus lens, and shipping is $6 without Prime.
amazon_match_notes: Exact colorway match per verified checker (SKU DRG150-017).
